schedulerDiagnostics.timing: elapsed target-to-actual callback/due-loop lateness; cumulative samples overlap wall time and are not CPU. Timer includes callback scheduling/work, not a root-cause attribution.

server.incrementalFallbackMeaning: fixed allowlisted reason counters, cumulative observed reason events (feature_disabled/not_strict are full-plan reasons, not actual fallbacks); not unique people or IDs; arbitrary text rejected
server.adapterMeaning: fixed store label; other includes unlabelled observations; original operation/stage aggregate remains unchanged
server.chPhaseMeaning: disjoint classification of the SAME ch_transport leaf events; never add phase view to adapter/stage view. calls=timed attempts; requests=actual fetch dispatches only when instrumented; null means unmeasured
server.selectedHydrationMeaning: authenticatedRows and selectedHydratedRows are cumulative counts observed only at facts temp_fill selected reads: full authenticated input versus actual inserted selected TEMP rows; not distinct people, not all authentication.rows, never add these views. Null/zero remain distinct.
server.incrementalCountMeaning: dirtyVisitors/reusedSessions/reusedOwnerHeads/rebuiltSessions/producedEffectRows/hydratedEffectRows/inputEvents are cumulative observed counts across plan invocations, including repeat work; not distinct people or unique effects. fullPlans/deltaPlans/fallbackPlans are emitted numeric plan indicators; unmeasured counts remain null. Only separately allowlisted fallback reason codes are emitted, never arbitrary text or identity
server.byteMeaning: requestBodyBytes=UTF8 POST body; responseBodyBytes=actual body chunks read, including partial failure; queryTextBytes=UTF8 SQL only, not parameters. Excludes URLs, headers, compression, TLS and network wire overhead. bytes retains historical adapter-specific definition; do not sum it with new byte fields

server.timing: totalMs is cumulative inclusive call duration across invocations; maxMs is maximum individual call. worker_facts_wall is each rebuild invocation elapsed time, includes PG/CH/authentication/waits. publication_readback_wall includes its leaf transfer plus parsing/hash/checksum verification, excludes following live fence; do not add it to leaf transport. session_build_wall covers buildSessionFacts reduction; remaining_ownership_wall covers original ownership/provenance loops, remaining_members_wall covers publication receipt/member PG inserts, remaining_complete_wall covers completeKind checks. These are inclusive elapsed timings, not query-only CPU. No child sums, overlapping requests or views establish CPU or elapsed proportions
server.identityRetention: bounded correlation set in memory only; no correlation IDs emitted

phaseMetrics.note: HTTP inclusive wall time and light PG probes only; no uninstrumented phase reported as zero
